channel.title: Zenfeed Blog
channel.description: Build logs and notes from building Zenfeed, a Chrome extension that declutters LinkedIn, X, and YouTube feeds.

item.title: Why muting is often better than unfollowing, and when it isn't
item.description: Muting and unfollowing solve different problems. A plain look at when each one is the right call, and why neither one is built for what a keyword filter does.

item.title: Why most focus apps try to stop you from opening the app, and we don't
item.description: One Sec adds a breathing pause. Opal and Freedom lock the app shut. Zenfeed skips that fight entirely and goes straight to what's inside the feed once you're there.

item.title: Why Rest from AI is a timer, not a permanent block
item.description: Rest from AI could have been a permanent filter instead of a countdown. Here's the reasoning behind building it as a timer — and why that's a better fit for a volume problem than a verdict is.

item.title: What actually clutters a LinkedIn feed in 2026 — it's not just ads anymore
item.description: Ads get blamed for a messy LinkedIn feed, but by 2026 they're only one piece of it. A plain-language look at what's actually crowding the feed, and a 2-minute way to check your own.

item.title: I let Claude Code rebuild my LinkedIn feed. Here's what actually happened.
item.description: No VC, no backend, and no single magic prompt. How Zenfeed got built, broke when LinkedIn changed its markup, and got fixed.
